defect: The generated auxiliary clock names unrelated_clk_i as its source even though the divider is driven by ref_clk_i.
rationale: aux_clk is a divided derivative of ref_clk_i. Giving it unrelated_clk as the parent misstates phase and frequency inheritance while the receiver is timed by aux_clk.

mutation.description: Changed the generated clock source from the real PLL reference port to an unrelated clock port.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: The auxiliary clock is produced from ref_clk_i, but its generated-clock source names unrelated_clk_i. phase_q[3] additionally has divide-by-sixteen frequency rather than the claimed divide-by-eight.
